heading: Confidence Points
body: Each week, rank every game by how confident you are. If a week has N games, you assign the numbers 1 through N — no repeats — with N going to your most confident pick. Get the pick right and you earn that many points; get it wrong and you earn zero.

heading: Tiebreaker
body: The Monday Night Football game each week doubles as your tiebreaker: guess the two teams' combined final score. Closest guess wins the tiebreak once the game goes final.

heading: Picks Lock
body: • Each week opens for picks the Tuesday at 6:00 AM following the previous week's Monday Night Football (Week 1 is always open).
• Every game locks at its own kickoff — not all at once. Miss Thursday night and the rest of the week stays open.

• A game that locks with nothing on it gets filled in for you: the home team to win, and the lowest points value you haven't used that week. It counts the same as any other pick, and it's marked Auto-filled on the board so you can see it wasn't yours. This applies to a single blank game or a week you never opened at all — nobody banks a zero for forgetting.
• Submitting doesn't freeze anything. It just marks your lineup as done for the standings. You can keep changing any game that hasn't kicked off.

heading: Survivor 🔒
body: Each week, lock in one team you think will win straight-up — separate from your confidence picks. You can only use each team as a lock once per season.

Double elimination. Your first losing lock is a strike and you stay in. The second one ends your Survivor season. Your confidence picks keep going either way. Survivor is its own contest — winning or losing it has no effect on your points.

Your lock stays open all week, but you can only choose from teams that haven't played yet. Once the team you locked kicks off, you're committed for that week — no watching them fall behind and swapping out.

heading: Standings & Scoring
body: • Points — your season total from correct confidence picks.
• Survivor — Alive, alive with a strike, or eliminated (❌) after two losing locks. Tracked independently of your points.

• Survivor is scored separately and never adds to or subtracts from your points. It used to be worth a 50-point bonus on a combined total; it isn't any more, so the standings rank on confidence points alone.

heading: Weekly Awards
body: Whoever scores the most points in a given week gets crowned 👑 King of the Week. Whoever scores the least gets the 🚽 — no further explanation needed.

heading: Trash Talk
body: Head to the Trash Talk board under the Menu to call your shot, clown a bad beat, or defend your picks. Everyone in the league sees every post.
